main_flow.label: Sepsis-3 ICU stays in MIMIC-IV v3.1
Adult first ICU stays continuing beyond hour 24
No coded malignancy or pregnancy-related condition
Sepsis onset by hour 24; alive and still in ICU at the landmark
At least 18 of 24 hourly invasive MAP values observed
Primary analysis cohort; 40 imputed hourly MAP datasets

exclusions.label: Repeat stays, age <18 years, or ICU stay ending by hour 24
Sepsis onset after hour 24 (2,109) or death by the landmark (92)
No or insufficient valid hourly invasive MAP observations
Missing first-day body weight before imputation

metadata.design: 24-hour landmark; onset is the later of qualifying SOFA and suspected-infection times
